name: Amasai
bio: Amasai was chief of the Thirty, David's elite warriors, in the days when David was still hiding from Saul. When he and other mighty men came to join David at his stronghold, David met them warily, uncertain whether they came in peace or to betray him. The Spirit came upon Amasai, and he declared, "We are yours, David... peace, peace to you, and peace to your helpers, for your God helps you." David received their words as confirmation and made them commanders of his band (1 Chronicles 12:16-18). He is a different figure from Amasa, the nephew Absalom and later David appointed over the army.
